Package fosalgo.pheroswarm

package fosalgo.pheroswarm
Provides PheroSwarm, a JavaFX simulator for decentralized drone swarm coverage on 2D grids.

Launcher starts the application. The editor and replay are managed by MainView and CanvasView. The simulation engine, DecentralizedExploration, selects frontiers using local occupancy maps and, in M1, a penalty derived from a shared digital pheromone field.

ExplorationConfig defines the settings for each run. M0 sets the pheromone weight to zero; M1 uses a positive weight. Coordinates are zero-based and indexed by row and column. The grid is a discrete experimental model, not a flight dynamics simulator.
